ValidationRule.description: Tax Id must be 2-letter region + hyphen + 9 digits, region must equal Region Code prefix, and the website slug must be lowercase and hyphenated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Tax_Id__c)), OR(NOT(REGEX(Tax_Id__c, '[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]{9}')), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Region_Code__c)), LEFT(Tax_Id__c, 2) <> LEFT(UPPER(Region_Code__c), 2)))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Website_Slug__c)), OR(Website_Slug__c <> LOWER(SUBSTITUTE(Website_Slug__c, ' ', '-')), CONTAINS(Website_Slug__c, '--'))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Tax Id, Region Code or Website Slug violate formatting rules.
